## Description

Testing of file download and upload operations, dynamic data loading, HTTP status codes, edge cases (broken images, auto-healing), and miscellaneous utility features. Covers file I/O, asynchronous content loading, and resilience scenarios.

## Pages Covered

| #   | Page Name                     | URL Path                         |
| --- | ----------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| 1   | Download File Demo            | `/download-file-demo`            |
| 2   | File Download                 | `/file-download`                 |
| 3   | JQuery Download Progress bars | `/jquery-download-progress-bars` |
| 4   | Status Codes                  | `/status-codes`                  |
| 5   | Dynamic Data Loading          | `/dynamic-data-loading`          |
| 6   | To-Do App                     | `/to-do-app`                     |
| 7   | Auto Healing                  | `/auto-healing`                  |
| 8   | Broken Image                  | `/broken-image`                  |
| 9   | Geolocation Testing           | `/geolocation-testing`           |
| 10  | Redirection                   | `/redirection`                   |

## What to Handle

- File download initiation and verification
- Download progress tracking
- Multiple file type downloads
- HTTP status code pages (200, 404, 500, etc.)
- Asynchronous data loading (XHR, fetch)
- Loading spinners and completion states
- To-Do CRUD operations (create, update, delete)
- Auto-healing/retry mechanisms
- Broken/missing image states
- Geolocation permission requests
- Page redirection and navigation

## Acceptance Criteria

- ✅ All 10 pages accessible
- ✅ File downloads can be triggered and tracked
- ✅ Download progress updates visible
- ✅ HTTP status pages load and display appropriately
- ✅ Dynamic data loads asynchronously
- ✅ To-Do app CRUD operations work
- ✅ Auto-healing retry mechanisms detected
- ✅ Broken images display fallback/error state
- ✅ Geolocation prompts handled
- ✅ Redirections followed correctly
- ✅ All tests use `setup('<page name>')` fixture
- ✅ Page objects created for file and dynamic interactions
- ✅ Assertions separate in dedicated files

## Out of Scope

- Actual download file content validation (file system level)
- Geolocation GPS accuracy testing
- Browser storage/cache interaction
- Real payment processing (status codes only)
- Network speed simulation/throttling
- Backup and recovery strategies
